mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS is above its 2-year rolling median, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases the risk-free rate and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 203.0) indicates a 'hawkish' monetary policy that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 203.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 203.0), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 203.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that may lead to inflationary pressures and policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is below its 2-year rolling median, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a decline in GDP (GDPC1) indicates a weakening supply chain and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 112.0 AND GDPC1 < 11500.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 370000.0 million dollars), strong consumer demand supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 370000.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
